differentiator: oh-my-pi wires the IDE's own machinery into the agent, so renames run through the language server and debugging attaches real debuggers, not guesses.

concepts.name: The wired-in IDE (CHOSEN)
concepts.world: A live app window, omp's own light editor theme on warm paper. We never cut to abstract type for long. We watch the machinery work inside the window.
concepts.shows: A rename cascades across the file tree on its own (language server). A debugger pauses at a breakpoint instead of a print. Then the money shot: a kernel cell where Python reads a file with tool.read and JavaScript charts it, never leaving the cell.
concepts.money_shot: The loopback cell reaching back into the agent's own tools. One place, wired to everything.
concepts.why_repost: It shows Can's actual engineering taste, the low-level moves a reverse engineer makes, not a star chart. He would repost a video that proves someone read the repo.
concepts.why_stop_scroll: You have never seen a coding agent's sandboxed code call back into the agent. The cell doing that stops the scroll.
concepts.light: Warm paper canvas, a solid dark editor window per screen_capture beat, deep magenta accents on the active elements. Bright by construction.

concepts.name: Hash vs line number
concepts.world: Split screen, two editors racing the same edit.
concepts.shows: Left editor loses the edit to a whitespace shift and a string-not-found error. Right editor anchors to a content hash and lands it clean.
concepts.money_shot: The hash anchor holding while the line numbers slide.
concepts.why_repost: Concrete and technical, but narrower than the wired-in story and it leans on one feature.
concepts.why_stop_scroll: The failure everyone knows (the agent edited the wrong line) resolved in real time.
concepts.light: Split polarity, one dark pane one light pane, natural contrast.

concepts.name: Reverse engineer's agent
concepts.world: A dark kernel-debugger aesthetic, register windows and breakpoints.
concepts.shows: The lldb / dlv / debugpy attach, a live stack, the agent stepping frames.
concepts.money_shot: A breakpoint catching the real bug.
concepts.why_repost: True to Can's background, but too inside-baseball for a scroll and it fights the brightness note by going dark.
concepts.why_stop_scroll: Weaker for a general AI-engineering audience; the debugger is one beat, not the whole story.

wow_bets: The loopback kernel cell as the money shot, a thing no other agent shows.
omp's own warm-paper light theme with a magenta accent, recognizable and bright, flipping off two straight dark videos.
A recurring app window we keep cutting back to, so the video feels like one continuous session, not a slideshow of templates.
